shared_elements: bird head in profile with prominent curved beak and rendered eye
wing/feathered surface treated with rows of incised repeating strokes
human-like arm and hand attached to a non-human body
handled or bag-like object with a curved top handle
horizontal band of repeated motifs running across the upper part of the surface
frontal/profile mixing of body parts within a single figure
justification: Both are shallow stone reliefs featuring hook-beaked bird heads in profile combined with human-like arms and a curved-handled bag-shaped object, and both place a horizontal band of repeated small motifs across the upper zone. The arrangement and manner differ sharply, however: A is a single monumental, finely detailed figure with dense textile and feather patterning filling a flat wall panel beside a stylised plant, while B is a rough, blocky pillar with several small, schematic creatures stacked in registers and little interior detail.
